title: Large Language Models are not Fair Evaluators
excerpt: Conflict Rate = conflicting results from the same evaluator when only comparison order is swapped. GPT-4 Vicuna-13b vs ChatGPT: Model-1 win 51.3%, Model-2 win 23.8%, conflict 37/80 (46%). ChatGPT evaluator: Model-1 win 2.5%, Model-2 win 82.5%, conflict 66/80 (82.5%). Vicuna-13b could beat ChatGPT on 66 over 80 tested queries with ChatGPT as the evaluator by order hacking.
